newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures end higher in last '96 session.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures end higher in last '96 session.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures settled higher on the last trading session of this year, as market sentiment remained bullish, traders said on Friday.
Prices were 0.7 yen to 1.3 yen per kg firmer than the previous day's close. Benchmark June was up 1.2 yen at 149.9.

"In addition to year-end book squaring, some buying interest in distant months was detected amid improved sentiment," one trader said. Slightly firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's weakness were cited as positive factors. Trading will resume on January 6 next year.
